request: JSON log entry encoding must succeed without an error when a level key is configured but no level encoder is supplied.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: JSON Encoder: Don't panic if EncodeLevel unset (#1058)

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > zapcore/json_encoder_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestNoEncodeLevelSupplied)$' ./zapcore >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
